name: 19004 · Bala Cynwyd, PA
findings: ZIP 19004 (Bala Cynwyd) has 169 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19004 (Bala Cynwyd) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19004 (Bala Cynwyd) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
